title: THE $200K TRAP
subtitle: Vance wants $200,000 to keep quiet.
summary: The car is trapped on the lift. With $4,900,000 left, Vance demands $200,000 to keep quiet. The crew must choose: pay him, or ram the door and run.
voteContext: The car is trapped on the lift. Vance wants $200,000 to keep quiet. Your comments decide Part 3.

title: THE CLEAN VAN
subtitle: A trooper spots the $100 bill in the latch.
summary: After paying Vance, the crew has $4,700,000 left. At 3:38 AM on Route 6, a trooper spots a $100 bill pinched in the van's latch. There are 45 seconds before he runs the plates. The crew must choose: BLUFF or BOLT.
voteContext: 45 seconds before the trooper runs the plates. He has spotted the $100 bill in the latch. Your comments decide Part 4.

Take the van into the fog.

title: THE $100 LIE
subtitle: $500,000 by sunrise—or the bodycam goes to the Feds.
summary: The trooper lets the crew go, but the bodycam becomes a new threat. At 4:19 AM in an empty car wash bay, the burner lights up: Vance gave the trooper their number. With $4,700,000 left, the crew faces a $500,000 demand by sunrise. The next choice: PAY or GHOST.
voteContext: Vance gave the trooper your number. $500,000 by sunrise—or the bodycam goes to the Feds. Your comments decide Part 5.

title: THE BRASS CHAIN
subtitle: The door is unlocked. Only the brass chain holds.
summary: The crew chose GHOST and kept $4,700,000. The trooper traced the last toll ping off Exit 14 and unlocked Room 8 with a master key. A brass chain holds the door. With the $500,000 extortion text saved, the next choice is LEVERAGE or LEAK.
voteContext: Only the brass chain holds Room 8's door. You still have proof of the $500,000 demand. Your comments decide Part 6.
choiceStrategies: Send the proof to State Police Dispatch.
